title: Have you found a car?
content: Have you found a car? Get in and drive. The roads fly past exits and forks but if you drive long enough there are some bridges. I’ve taken the bridges and driven to other small cities. It’s all pretty much the same though. For some reason I drive for too long last night only to end up in a slightly different mall structure and I was being told I would have to do a weekend in a jail. As I prepared myself for this imprisonment I woke up. Of course these are dreams but these malls have to be something a bit deeper right?
